### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Hold Connect a model until its Organization owners are known, and scope organization discovery failures per installation](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3480) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On Connect a model, `Connect model` waits until the portal knows which Organizations you may add a model for, so a model meant for an Organization isn't saved to the platform by mistake. Editing a model is no longer held up by another environment's failure.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.38.7...v3.38.8
